DECLARATION.TITLE: Accessibility statement
DECLARATION.TEXT: izyGlam is committed to making its services accessible to as many people as possible. Our goal is WCAG 2.2 AA compliance and alignment with RGAA (France), where feasible.

SCOPE.TITLE: Scope covered
SCOPE.L2: Web app (dashboard) for clients and professionals.

STATUS.TITLE: Compliance status
STATUS.TEXT: As of this statement, izyGlam interfaces are partially compliant with WCAG 2.2 AA / RGAA. We continually improve and fix priority gaps.

PREPARATION.TITLE: How this statement was prepared
PREPARATION.L1: Self-assessments by product/UI teams: HTML semantics, ARIA roles, tab order.
PREPARATION.L2: Manual tests: keyboard navigation, visible focus, 200%+ zoom, screen readers.
PREPARATION.L3: Tooled tests (automated audits on sample screens).
PREPARATION.L4: Ongoing QA during updates (Design System, reusable accessible components).

KEYBOARD.TITLE: Keyboard navigation
KEYBOARD.L1: Full keyboard journey (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Esc, arrows).
KEYBOARD.L3: “Skip to content” links to bypass header.
KEYBOARD.L4: Menus, modals, and dropdowns operable by keyboard (open/close, managed focus trap, close with Esc).

SCREENREADERS.TITLE: Screen readers & structure
SCREENREADERS.L1: Semantic structure with headings (h1→h6) and landmarks (header, nav, main, footer).
SCREENREADERS.L2: Explicit labels for all fields and buttons; consistent accessible names.
SCREENREADERS.L3: Announce state changes via aria-live regions (errors, success, loading).
SCREENREADERS.L4: Informative images with descriptive alt; decorative images ignored.

CONTRAST.TITLE: Contrast, color, and scaling
CONTRAST.L1: Target contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for normal text and ≥ 3:1 for large text.
CONTRAST.L2: Interface usable up to 200% zoom without loss of content or function.
CONTRAST.L3: No information conveyed by color alone.

FORMS.TITLE: Forms and error messages
FORMS.L2: Errors shown near the field and summarized if needed.
FORMS.L3: Focus moved to the first errored field with guidance to fix.

DYNAMIC.TITLE: Dynamic content & animations
DYNAMIC.L2: Respect “reduce motion” system preference where possible.
DYNAMIC.L3: Non-intrusive modals, closable via keyboard and outside click.

MEDIA.TITLE: Media
MEDIA.L1: Videos (if any) with captions and/or transcripts.

MOBILE.TITLE: Mobile
MOBILE.L2: Navigation consistent with TalkBack (Android) and VoiceOver (iOS).

NONACCESSIBLE.TITLE: Non-accessible content (observed or potential)
NONACCESSIBLE.TEXT: Despite our efforts, some elements may remain non-compliant:
NONACCESSIBLE.L1: Older images without descriptive alt text.
NONACCESSIBLE.L2: Third-party documents (PDF, attachments) not fully accessible.
NONACCESSIBLE.L4: Embedded third-party components (payments, maps, players) with their own limits.
NONACCESSIBLE.MOTIVES: Possible reasons: third-party content, disproportionate burden, in-progress updates.

ACCOMMODATIONS.TITLE: Alternatives & reasonable accommodations
ACCOMMODATIONS.TEXT: If you need an alternative format (e.g., accessible document, booking assistance), contact us. We’ll do our best to offer an equivalent solution.

FEEDBACK.TITLE: Feedback & assistance
FEEDBACK.L3: Please include the screen/URL, device, browser, and any screen reader used.

RECOURSE.TITLE: Appeal procedure (France)
RECOURSE.TEXT: If you encounter an accessibility issue preventing access to content or a feature, and you cannot get a satisfactory response from us, you can:
RECOURSE.L1: Write to the Défenseur des droits or its local delegate,
RECOURSE.L2: Or contact the Mediator where applicable.

CONTINUOUS.TITLE: Continuous improvement
CONTINUOUS.L2: Code review and accessibility testing at each release.
CONTINUOUS.L3: Regular training for product and support teams.
CONTINUOUS.L4: Prioritization of fixes by user impact.

DATE.TITLE: Statement date & updates
DATE.TEXT: Statement issued on December 25, 2025. It will be updated at least once a year or upon major changes.

HELP.QUESTION12: Can I book for someone else (gift, surprise)?
HELP.QUESTION13: How do I become a partner professional onizyGlam?
HELP.QUESTION14: How do I protect my personal information onizyGlam?
HELP.REPONSE1: It’s simple and fast. Once registered, choose the service you’re interested in, discover available professionals near you, then select a date and time. Click “Book” to finalize and pay by card. Your booking will then be manually validated by the professional. If refused, you’ll be fully refunded.
HELP.REPONSE2: Each professional has a detailed profile with services, prices, photos of work, and client reviews. You can also add favorites to find them easily. Take time to compare profiles and choose the one that best fits your expectations.
HELP.REPONSE3: You can modify or cancel your booking from your personal area. Cancellations are free up to 24h before the service. Beyond that, fees may apply. If you have an issue, our support team is here to help.
HELP.REPONSE4: Log in to your personal area, under “My bookings.” You’ll find real-time tracking, the option to cancel or modify, and your service history.
HELP.REPONSE5: Payment is by bank card only (Visa, MasterCard, American Express). We don’t offer cash or PayPal at this time. Everything is secured for your peace of mind.
HELP.REPONSE6: Once your booking is confirmed, you’ll receive a summary email. We’ll also send a reminder before the service (by email and/or push). You can also track the status from your personal area.
HELP.REPONSE7: Yes. After each completed service, you’re invited to leave a review. Reviews are manually moderated to ensure authenticity. Professionals cannot reply to or modify reviews.
HELP.REPONSE8: For now,izyGlam doesn’t yet offer a loyalty program or promo codes. These features are planned for a later phase.
HELP.REPONSE9: You can contact us directly via the “Contact” section or by email. Our team will do its best to respond within 24h (indicative) and help resolve the issue as quickly as possible.
HELP.REPONSE10: You can reach us via the contact form on the site or app. Customer support is available Monday to Saturday, 9am–6pm. Example email: support@izyglam.com
HELP.REPONSE11: You can cancel free of charge up to 24h before the scheduled time. After that, fees may apply. If your booking is refused by the professional, the refund is automatic. The automatic refund system is being rolled out.
HELP.REPONSE12: You can’t yet gift a service to someone else from your account. However, if a professional offers a duo or family package, you can book for several people in that specific context.
HELP.REPONSE13: Are you an esthetician, hairdresser, or well-being practitioner? Join the izyGlam community by filling out the form on the “Become a partner” page. Our team will contact you quickly to finalize your registration.
HELP.REPONSE14: Your data security is our priority. We comply with GDPR. Only information strictly necessary for the service is accessible to professionals. An integrated messenger lets you chat if needed, but any attempt to bypass the platform will be monitored.

WHO.TITLE: Who are we?
WHO.TEXT: This Privacy Policy explains how izyGlam (hereinafter “we,” “us,” or “the Platform”) collects, uses, stores, shares, and protects your personal data when you use our services (website, web app, mobile app, emails, and support). We act as the data controller for the processing described below.

SCOPE.TITLE: Policy scope
SCOPE.TEXT: This policy applies to clients who book services, professionals who offer services via izyGlam, and visitors of our interfaces.

PROVIDED.TITLE: Data you provide
PROVIDED.L1: Identity & contact: name, first name, email, phone, address(es), photo/avatars.
PROVIDED.L3: Bookings: services chosen, date/time, service addresses, notes, attachments.
PROVIDED.L4: Payment: payment information via our provider (e.g., Stripe) — we do not store your card data.
PROVIDED.L5: Professionals: public profile, services, rates, travel areas, availability, bank details (secured), verification documents if required.
PROVIDED.L6: Support: messages, tickets, call recordings where applicable.

AUTOMATIC.TITLE: Data collected automatically
AUTOMATIC.L1: Technical data: device model, OS, browser, resolutions, session IDs.
AUTOMATIC.L2: Logging: IP addresses, timestamps, error events, feature usage.
AUTOMATIC.L3: Location: approximate (IP) or precise (GPS, with your explicit consent).

PURPOSES.TITLE: Purposes & legal bases
PURPOSES.TEXT: We process data for the following purposes:
PURPOSES.L1: Provide the service (account creation, booking, matching, notifications) — Basis: contract performance.

SHARING.TITLE: Data sharing
SHARING.L1: Professionals / Clients: information necessary for the service (name, contact method, service address, booking details).
SHARING.L2: Processors: payments (e.g., Stripe), hosting/storage, analytics, email/SMS push, support, KYC if needed. Limited access under GDPR-compliant contracts.
SHARING.L3: Partners: if you consent for specific offers.
SHARING.L4: Authorities: when required by law or to defend our rights.

TRANSFERS.TITLE: Transfers outside the EU/EEA
TRANSFERS.TEXT: Where data is transferred to countries without an adequacy decision, we use Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and implement supplementary measures.

RETENTION.TITLE: Retention periods
RETENTION.L1: Account & identity: while the account is in use, then up to 3 years after last activity (prospecting) or 5–10 years for accounting/legal obligations.
RETENTION.NOTE: Afterwards, data is deleted or anonymized.

COOKIES.TITLE: Cookies & SDKs
COOKIES.TEXT: We use cookies/SDKs to run the Platform, measure audience, prevent fraud, and—with your consent—personalize the experience.
COOKIES.PREF: You can manage your preferences anytime via the banner and your browser settings.

AUTOMATION.TITLE: Automated decisions & profiling
AUTOMATION.TEXT: We may use automated signals (e.g., fraud risk, provider availability, distance) to prioritize actions or suggest time slots. No decisions with significant legal effects are made without human involvement unless legally required or with your explicit consent.

RIGHTS.TITLE: Your rights (GDPR)
RIGHTS.L3: Right to object to processing based on legitimate interest.
RIGHTS.L4: Right to withdraw consent at any time.
RIGHTS.L5: Right to file a complaint with the CNIL.
RIGHTS.CONTACT: To exercise your rights, contact us:
RIGHTS.VERIFY: We may ask for additional information to verify your identity.

SECURITY.TITLE: Security
SECURITY.TEXT: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures: encryption in transit (TLS), password hashing, logging and monitoring, access control, backups, code review, and security testing.

MINORS.TITLE: Data of minors
MINORS.TEXT: Our services are not intended for persons under 15. If a minor account is identified, we will delete it after verification.

SUBPROCESSORS.TITLE: Main subprocessors
SUBPROCESSORS.TEXT: We work with essential subprocessors for hosting, payments, emailing, analytics, and storage. An up-to-date list can be provided on request at

CHANGES.TITLE: Changes to this policy
CHANGES.TEXT: We may update this policy to reflect legal or functional changes. In case of significant changes, we will notify you by email or via the app. Effective date: August 11, 2025.

LOCAL.TITLE: Local provisions
LOCAL.TEXT: If you are located in the European Union, your data is processed in accordance with GDPR. Country- or region-specific addenda may apply and will be communicated where relevant.

GLOSSARY.TITLE: Glossary (excerpt)
GLOSSARY.L1: Data controller: entity that determines the purposes and means of processing.
GLOSSARY.L2: Processor: entity that processes data on behalf of the controller.
GLOSSARY.L3: Legal basis: ground authorizing processing (contract, consent, legal obligation, legitimate interest).
GLOSSARY.L4: Cookies/SDKs: trackers used by the site/app to provide, measure, and personalize the service.

ACCEPT.TITLE: Acceptance of the Terms
ACCEPT.TEXT: By accessing izyGlam’s services (website, web app, mobile app), you unreservedly accept these Terms of Use (“Terms”). If you do not accept these Terms, you must not use the Platform.

DEFINITIONS.TITLE: Definitions
DEFINITIONS.L1: Client: any person who books and/or pays for a service on the Platform.
DEFINITIONS.L2: Professional: any person who offers services via the Platform.
DEFINITIONS.L3: Service: a service offered by a Professional (e.g., at-home beauty).
DEFINITIONS.L4: Platform: the software infrastructure, websites and applications operated by izyGlam.

SERVICE_ROLE.TITLE: Services and izyGlam’s Role
SERVICE_ROLE.TEXT: izyGlam is a matchmaking platform. Professionals are solely responsible for the services they provide (quality, compliance, insurance). Unless otherwise stated, izyGlam is neither the seller nor the provider of these services and does not assume responsibility for their performance.

ACCOUNT.TITLE: Account and Eligibility
ACCOUNT.L1: Registration is required to book or offer a service. You agree to provide accurate information and keep it up to date.
ACCOUNT.L2: You must be at least 15 years old to use the Platform. Professionals must be legally authorized to practice.
ACCOUNT.L3: You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for any activity carried out from your account.
ACCOUNT.L4: izyGlam reserves the right to suspend or terminate an account in case of violation of the Terms or a proven risk of fraud.

BOOKINGS.TITLE: Bookings and Formation of the Contract
BOOKINGS.L1: Services are booked and paid for online by the Client. No cash is due on site.
BOOKINGS.L2: The booking is subject to validation by the Professional after payment. If refused, the Client is fully refunded.
BOOKINGS.L3: The service contract is concluded directly between the Client and the Professional upon acceptance.
BOOKINGS.L4: Schedules, service addresses and any specific conditions must be checked by the parties.

PRICES_PAYMENTS.TITLE: Pricing, Subscriptions and Payments
PRICES_PAYMENTS.L1: Service prices are freely set by Professionals. izyGlam applies a platform commission.
PRICES_PAYMENTS.L2: Subscriptions for Professionals (current example): 1 shop free for life; Basic: 3 shops – €99 / month; Premium: 10 shops – €499 / month; beyond: quote.
PRICES_PAYMENTS.L3: Payment by bank card only via a provider (e.g., Stripe). No cash, no promo codes or loyalty program at this stage.
PRICES_PAYMENTS.L4: Amounts, taxes and applicable fees are shown before confirmation. Subscription terms may evolve; changes will be communicated in advance.

CANCELLATIONS.TITLE: Cancellation, Refund and No-Show
CANCELLATIONS.L1: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the scheduled service time.
CANCELLATIONS.L2: Within 24 hours, fees may apply according to the current policy.
CANCELLATIONS.L3: If the Professional refuses after payment, the Client is refunded 100%. Automation of refunds is being rolled out; where applicable, support will initiate the operation.
CANCELLATIONS.L4: No-shows (unreported absence) may result in fees or the impossibility of a refund.

PAYOUTS.TITLE: Payouts to Professionals
PAYOUTS.L1: Payout to the Professional is triggered upon confirmation of completion of the service (e.g., confirmation of a validation code).
PAYOUTS.L2: The bank details (RIB/IBAN) provided by the Professional are used for the transfer. The Professional guarantees the accuracy of their banking information.
PAYOUTS.L3: Amounts paid correspond to the service price less the commission and applicable fees.

RESPONSIBILITIES.TITLE: Responsibilities of the Parties
RESPONSIBILITIES.L1: Professionals ensure the compliance of their services, regulatory adherence, hygiene and safety.
RESPONSIBILITIES.L2: Clients agree to provide accurate information (address, availability, access constraints) and to keep appointments.
RESPONSIBILITIES.L3: izyGlam provides the Platform and tools (booking, payment, messaging) but does not guarantee the outcome of a service.

REVIEWS.TITLE: Reviews and Ratings
REVIEWS.L1: Reviews may be left only after a service has actually been performed.
REVIEWS.L2: Reviews may be subject to moderation (e.g., removal of content contrary to the law or these Terms).

PROHIBITED.TITLE: Prohibited Behavior
